label: GO after a rare-rewarded a2 trial (a2 -> S1, rewarded) when the agent sticks with a2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass), never at D1 or D2. Almost all mass (88%) falls on GO steps whose previous trial was a2, took the rare transition to S1, and was rewarded. That is the case where a model-based agent should switch to a1, but the feature fires mostly when the agent repeats a2 (model_act == 2: 95% of mass; choice logit strongly favours a2; value is low). It grows with episode position: essentially zero before trial 30, highest for trials 80-99. The base predicate (GO, prev a2, rare, rewarded) gets F1 0.57 and mass recall 0.88 on dev. Adding the agent own GO choice (a2) and ep_trial >= 40 raises F1 to 0.73 (precision 0.88, mass recall 0.84). All variables are observed or are the agent own choice. Strongest activations come after runs of repeated a2 -> S1 rare transitions. Weak misses are mostly window-first trials where the previous trial is unknown, plus scattered GO steps after other histories. False positives are mostly cases where the agent switches to a1 or which fall early in the episode.
